analysis.visual_description: On the board. The folder open. A single private leaf, no name at the head. The clove has done less since the play than it did during it.
On the board. He strikes through my and writes thy above the line, and then he sits a long while with his hands off the paper.
On the board. He strikes through thy, writes my beside it, and turns the leaf face down into the folder. No name has been added. He does not hand it to anyone.
